newsitem.title: USA: Clinton, Democrats meet on budget 1345 EST/1745 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Clinton, Democrats meet on budget 1345 EST/1745 GMT.

text.p: President Bill Clinton will meet with Democrats from the House of Representatives, including members of its budget committee, at 1345 EST (1745 GMT) on Wednesday, White House spokesman Mike McCurry said.
"We've got a very large group of House Democrats coming to talk about budget-related issues," McCurry told reporters, adding that some members of the House Budget Committee were expected to attend.
McCurry declined to say whether the talks were making progress.
"I don't have anything on where they are, but there are discussions underway and the president wants to actively consult with our friends on the hill about where the dialogue is going," McCurry said.
"He's going to work real hard to see if we can't achieve a bipartisan balanced budget agreement, which would be in the best interests of this nation and its economy," he added.
McCurry said that Clinton's meeting with the House Democrats would take place in the White House residence and was expected to last until about 1500 EST (1900 GMT).
